test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Atulit has 100 apples. He gave 10% of the apples to Arnav, 15% of the apples to Keshav and 2/5th of the apples to Rinku. How many apples are left with Atulit after distribution?
solution:
**Given:**

Total apples = 100

Apples given to Arnav = 10% of 100

Apples given to Keshav = 15% of 100

Apples given to Rinku = (2)/(5) of 100

**Formula Used:**

Remaining apples = Total apples - (Apples given to Arnav + Apples given to Keshav + Apples given to Rinku)

**Calculation:**

Apples given to Arnav = 10% of 100

⇒ Apples given to Arnav = 10/100 × 100

⇒ Apples given to Arnav = 10

Apples given to Keshav = 15% of 100

⇒ Apples given to Keshav = 15/100 × 100

⇒ Apples given to Keshav = 15

Apples given to Rinku = (2)/(5) of 100

⇒ Apples given to Rinku = 2/5 × 100

⇒ Apples given to Rinku = 40

Remaining apples = 100 - (10 + 15 + 40)

⇒ Remaining apples = 100 - 65

⇒ Remaining apples = 35

**The number of apples left with Atulit after distribution is 35.**
